messages:
sam: FYI we're seeing intermittent mTLS failures between svc-ingest-eu (eu-west) clients and svc-store-ap (ap-northeast). Starts ~4130UTC after yesterday's RBAC rollout. TL;DR: KMS unwraps failing because the unwrap call is hitting a eu-west key ARN while running from ap-northeast hosts.
mei: can you paste the audit line?
sam: log: "ts=4123456795 api=Decrypt principal=system:serviceaccount:prod:svc-ingest-eu key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:987654:key/def... src_region=ap-northeast-1 result=AccessDenied"
saurav: that smells like key-alias resolution leaking across clusters. We changed cert-manager caching to share issuer metadata for performance, maybe cache invalidation bug.
lisa: also note we tightened pod-level IAM yesterday (IRSA bindings). If the service account now maps to a more-restricted role that doesn't have kms:Decrypt in ap-northeast, unwraps will fail even if the key policy permits it in eu-west.
oncall-amy: sec-bot fired multiple alerts: [ALERT] 4123456800 cross-region-kms-decrypt-failures count=18 affected=svc-ingest-eu.
sec-bot: [AUDIT] 4123456810 correlated events show key_region=eu-west-1, request_region=ap-northeast-1, principal=system:serviceaccount:prod:svc-ingest-eu. Suggested runbook: kb/ops/kms-cross-region-debug.
mei: quick checks: 1) are the pods using node IAM or IRSA? 2) which key alias did cert-manager pick? 3) did the RBAC PR change the trust mapping for the SA?
sam: pods use IRSA; SA->role mapping changed yesterday in PR #5121 to remove a broad kms:Decrypt in favor of tighter permissions. I assumed certs are pre-provisioned in each region but logs disagree.
saurav: hypothesis: cert-manager chooses a key alias based on model image region of the controller (eu-west) and caches it. When it provisions certs for ap-northeast workloads, it reuses the eu-west alias. The unwrap call then arrives from ap-northeast with principal that doesn't have decrypt permission for eu-west key.
lisa: we need two fixes: immediate mitigation to restore traffic, and a durable fix so cert-manager never reuses remote aliases.
mei: mitigation options: a) temporarily add kms:Decrypt to the mapped role but restrict to the specific key ARN and to requests where request.region==ap-northeast (KMS conditions are limited, but we can use aws:SourceIp or aws:ViaAWSService). b) change the key policy to explicitly allow the role for Decrypt (scoped, logged). c) force cert-manager to use a local alias by restarting controllers with disable-global-cache flag.
oncall-amy: ops prefers (c) + short-lived (b) if (c) is slow. We can restart cert-manager canaries in ap-northeast first.
sec-bot: [QUERY] 4123456825 run: "select top 5 from kms_audit where api='Decrypt' and request_region!=key_region and principal like '%svc-ingest%'" -> results: 5 rows, all key_region=eu-west-1, request_region=ap-northeast-1.
sam: confirms cross-region unwraps.
saurav: I'm going to patch cert-manager: add strict alias lookup (prefer issuer.region match) and a TTL=30s on cached issuer entries. I'll open PR and roll into canary in ap-northeast.
lisa: I'll revert the IRSA role diff for svc-ingest-eu to re-add scoped kms:Decrypt during the window. I'll create a policy that is explicit: Statement allowing "kms:Decrypt" for Resource "arn:aws:kms:ap-northeast-1:987654:key/ghi..." and Principle role arn:aws:iam::987654:role/irsa-svc-ingest-eu-temp, and tag it with a 12h expiration ticket.
mei: make sure to include an audit annotation: who approved, change-id, and automatic revoke job. We need a paper trail.
oncall-amy: approved for 12h emergency exception, scope=single key in ap-northeast, principal=irsa-svc-ingest-eu-temp, logged.
sec-bot: [AUDIT NOTE] 4123456860 temporary exception created id=tmp-4123456860 expires=4123500460 created_by=oncall-amy.
sam: after cert-manager patch lands, we'll rotate certs for affected pods to ensure they pick local aliases. Also add an alert: metric cert_alias_region_mismatch{host_region,alias_region} and fire if >3/min.
saurav: add unit test in cert-manager that simulates multi-controller alias cache and ensures region affinity.
lisa: postmortem items: 1) don't share issuer cache across regions, 2) ensure IRSA mapping tests catch role changes that remove KMS access for region-local keys, 3) add KMS audit rule that flags Decrypt calls where key_region!=request_region for internal principals.
mei: oncall, please run the KMS query for the last 24h and paste top 10 entries here once you have them. We'll re-evaluate once the temporary exception expires.
oncall-amy: running now, will post results in ~5m.
sec-bot: [FOLLOWUP] 4123457005 query complete, results uploaded to /audit/kms/4123457005.csv
sam: thanks team, prioritize the cert-manager canary in ap-northeast and the scoped IRSA exception expirations. We'll sync again after canary. :white_check_mark:
